ThingDef.label: goblin bone hammer
ThingDef.description: A simple hammer made from a dense bone bound in human leather. It is crude, ugly, and useful for hitting both people and loose fittings.

ThingDef.label: goblin bone club
ThingDef.description: A wooden club edged with sharpened bones. It bruises, tears, and leaves ugly wounds even when the blow itself is clumsy.

ThingDef.label: goblin bone axe
ThingDef.description: A jawbone worked into an axe blade. It is light for an axe and can chop wood, doors, or limbs with equal enthusiasm.

ThingDef.label: goblin bone spear
ThingDef.description: A sharpened bone point fixed to a long shaft. It gives small fighters just enough reach to feel brave.

li.label: Throw bone spear
li.description: Throw the bone spear at a target. The spear remains equipped, but the throw takes time to recover from.

ThingDef.label: goblin dagger
ThingDef.description: A short goblin-alloy knife with a bone grip. It is not elegant, but it is fast and mean.

ThingDef.label: goblin cleaver
ThingDef.description: A broad one-handed blade made for butchery first and swordplay second. Goblins rarely care about the distinction.

ThingDef.label: goblin curved blade
ThingDef.description: A hooked field blade adapted into a weapon. Its edge is made for harvesting, whether the crop is grain or a throat.

ThingDef.label: goblin axe
ThingDef.description: A crude metal axe with a back spike. It is comfortable around doors, trees, armor plates, and other things that need ruining.

ThingDef.label: goblin spear
ThingDef.description: A simple goblin-alloy spear. It is cheap, cruelly practical, and just long enough to let an untrained fighter become a problem.

ThingDef.label: goblin banner spear
ThingDef.description: A goblin-alloy spear with a ragged banner tied beneath the point. It fights like a spear, but announces the mob before the mob arrives.

ThingDef.label: goblin mace
ThingDef.description: A heavy goblin-alloy mace decorated with a skull. It is inelegant, but armor does not stay elegant after meeting it either.

ThingDef.label: goblin flail
ThingDef.description: A threshing tool turned into a battlefield hazard. It is awkward with shields, but it has a talent for finding bones behind armor.

ThingDef.label: goblin machete
ThingDef.description: A large, crude blade carried by goblin shock troops. It is front-heavy, ugly, and very persuasive.

ThingDef.label: goblin staff sling
ThingDef.description: A staff sling made from wood and human leather. It throws large stones slowly, loudly, and with a worrying amount of joy.

ThingDef.label: goblin warbow
ThingDef.description: A heavy composite bow built from bone and wood. It hits harder than most bows, but pulling it is slow work.

ThingDef.label: goblin crossbow
ThingDef.description: A middle-weight crossbow with a blade fixed under the stock. It is simple to aim and unpleasant to be near.

ThingDef.label: goblin repeating crossbow
ThingDef.description: A lever-fed crossbow that trades power and range for a nervous stream of bolts.

ThingDef.label: goblin arquebus
ThingDef.description: A shortened matchlock that can be fired with one hand. It is loud, smoky, inaccurate, and still dangerous.

ThingDef.label: goblin matchlock
ThingDef.description: A full-sized goblin matchlock with a fixed blade. It reloads slowly, but the ball hits far harder than its crude barrel deserves.

ThingDef.label: goblin handgonne
ThingDef.description: A basic gunpowder weapon made by binding three barrels to the end of a wooden pole. Goblins usually pack it with shot to make up for its poor accuracy. "Uuh... heavy... loud stick heavy..."

ThingDef.label: goblin handcannon
ThingDef.description: A short, ugly bomb thrower built like a firearm. It is meant for breaking cover, doors, and plans.

ThingDef.label: goblin sleep-gas bottle
ThingDef.description: A sealed bottle of goblin meat, guts, herbs, and bone dust left to ferment until the slurry becomes violently reactive. When it shatters, the compressed stink blooms into a choking sleep-gas cloud that goblins tolerate better than anyone else.\n\n"Here! Me dad in bottle! Made from dad guts! Humans sniff and go coco-sleep!"

ThingDef.label: goblin blowdart
ThingDef.description: A narrow wooden tube for firing poisoned darts. Its wounds are tiny; the toxin is the point.

ThingDef.label: goblin chain snare
ThingDef.description: A hooked chain for dragging and hobbling enemies. It can still be swung like a crude flail in close quarters.

ThingDef.label: goblin shaman staff
ThingDef.description: A bone-tipped ritual staff. It can deploy a mobile low-angle shield that helps nearby allies focus their attacks.

ThingDef.label: staff of maddening rapture
ThingDef.description: A blessed goblin shaman staff. It carries the base moving low-shield, and can overload a target's mind into psychic shock — the victim's face looks blissful, though it is anything but.

ThingDef.label: staff of the seething gland
ThingDef.description: A blessed goblin shaman staff. It carries the base moving low-shield, can purge goblin toxic pheromones from an ally, and can violently release absorbed pheromone particles as a burst of gas and electromagnetic force.

ThingDef.label: goblin boomstick
ThingDef.description: A crude bomb lashed to a stick. Sometimes the fuse catches, and then everyone nearby learns about goblin engineering.
